The slide features a large bold title 'Learned Metric' positioned at the top-left. The main body of the slide is occupied by a horizontal flowchart depicting a Siamese neural network architecture. On the left side, there are two parallel input paths labeled '3D Wireframe i + GT' and '3D Wireframe j + GT', which lead to rendered wireframe images. These images are fed into two identical blue trapezoidal blocks labeled 'DINOv2', each topped with an ice cube icon suggesting frozen weights. Following these are two green rectangular 'MLP' blocks, marked with fire icons to indicate they are trainable, and connected by a vertical arrow labeled 'shared'. The MLPs produce scores 'g(r_i)' and 'g(r_j)', which converge on the right side into a mathematical equation: 'σ(g(r_i) - g(r_j)) ≈ p(i > j)'. Below this equation, a downward arrow points to the final objective, 'BCE loss'. The slide uses a clean white background with moderate text density, relying on visual icons and flow arrows to explain the methodology.
